description: 전북특별자치도_보건환경연구원 도로변대기측정망 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 전북특별자치도. 이 데이터는 교통량과 대기오염의 상관관계를 분석하고, 도로변에 거주하거나 통행하는 시민들의 건강에 미치는 영향을 평가하는 데 중요한 기초 자료입니다. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
